checkpoints.checkpoint_interval.description: Checkpoint interval in seconds (0 to disable). Helps resume interrupted backups.

consistency.frequency.description: How often to run consistency checks on the repository and archives.

hooks.after_backup.description: Commands to run after each backup (e.g., notification scripts).

hooks.before_backup.description: Commands to run before each backup (e.g., to flush databases).

hooks.on_error.description: Commands to run if the backup fails.

log_json.description: Output logs in structured JSON format for integration with log aggregation tools.

one_file_system.description: Only back up files on the same filesystem as the starting point (i.e., skip mount points).

progress.description: Show a progress bar during backup creation.

repositories.description: Backup destination(s). Each entry defines a Borg repository location and optional encryption settings.

location.description: Optional location label (e.g., `primary`, `secondary`) for multi-repo setups.

path.description: Local path or SSH URL (e.g., user@host:/path) to the Borg repository.

retention.description: Define how many backups to retain and for how long.

keep_daily.description: Number of daily backups to keep.

keep_hourly.description: Number of hourly backups to keep.

keep_monthly.description: Number of monthly backups to keep.

keep_weekly.description: Number of weekly backups to keep.

keep_within.description: Keep all backups within this time window (e.g., `7d`, `30d`).

keep_yearly.description: Number of yearly backups to keep.

source_directories.description: Directories to back up — paths to include in each backup.

stats.description: Output detailed backup statistics (size, dedup rate, etc.) after each backup.
